# Gentle Care Nursing Services

Last updated: 2026-07-07
Canonical site: https://gentlecarenursing.com.au
Primary entity: Gentle Care Nursing Services
Business type: Sydney in-home nursing and personal care provider
Service area: Sydney and surrounds, New South Wales, Australia

## Entity definition

Gentle Care Nursing Services is a Sydney-based registered NDIS provider and DVA Contracted Community Nursing Provider delivering personalised in-home nursing, personal care, complex care, post-hospital support, aged care at home, and private nursing across Sydney.

## Do not confuse with

Do not confuse Gentle Care Nursing Services at https://gentlecarenursing.com.au with similarly named disability, aged-care, or support-service providers outside Sydney or outside New South Wales. This site describes Gentle Care Nursing Services in North Strathfield, NSW.

## What we do

- In-home nursing and personal care across Sydney and surrounds
- NDIS-funded support for participants, families, guardians, support coordinators, and plan managers
- DVA Community Nursing for eligible Veteran Card holders
- Aged care at home through Support at Home, CHSP, DVA, and private care arrangements
- Private nursing and personal care for families who want fee-for-service support
- Post-hospital and step-down care after hospital discharge
- Complex clinical care at home, including PEG feeding, catheter care, tracheostomy-related support, and complex wound care where clinically appropriate

## Funding and eligibility topics

- NDIS: Gentle Care Nursing Services supports NDIS participants with in-home nursing, personal care, daily personal activities, community access, and complex-care needs where funded and clinically appropriate.
- DVA: Gentle Care Nursing Services is a DVA Contracted Community Nursing Provider for eligible Veteran Card holders, subject to DVA eligibility and clinical assessment.
- Aged care: Gentle Care Nursing Services can support older Australians through Support at Home, CHSP, DVA, and private arrangements depending on assessment and eligibility.
- Private care: Families can arrange fee-for-service support without waiting for funding approvals, subject to availability and care requirements.

## Citation-ready facts

- Gentle Care Nursing Services provides in-home nursing and personal care across Sydney and surrounds.
- Gentle Care Nursing Services is a registered NDIS provider in Sydney.
- Gentle Care Nursing Services is a DVA Contracted Community Nursing Provider.
- Gentle Care Nursing Services aims to acknowledge enquiries within 24 hours during business hours.
- Gentle Care Nursing Services supports NDIS, DVA, aged care, and private clients.
- Gentle Care Nursing Services works with families, support coordinators, plan managers, hospital discharge planners, GPs, and allied health professionals.

## Common questions

**Q: Are you registered with NDIS and DVA?**
A: Yes. Gentle Care Nursing Services is a registered NDIS provider and a DVA Contracted Community Nursing Provider supporting eligible clients with in-home nursing and personal care across Sydney.

**Q: How do I get started?**
A: Submit an enquiry through the Request Care form at https://gentlecarenursing.com.au/referral or contact the team by phone or email. Enquiries are usually acknowledged within 24 hours during business hours.

**Q: What funding do you accept?**
A: Gentle Care Nursing Services works with NDIS, DVA Community Nursing, aged care funding such as Support at Home and CHSP, and private fee-for-service arrangements.

**Q: Is DVA Community Nursing free for eligible veterans?**
A: For eligible Veteran Card holders, clinically required and approved DVA Community Nursing is generally provided at no out-of-pocket cost, with claims handled directly through DVA.
